name: Opportunistic Archer (Ex)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Advanced Rogue Talents, Distracted Shot.

Benefit: When a rogue with this talent makes a ranged attack against an enemy that is threatened by at least two of her allies, she counts as flanking that opponent, gaining all the benefits of flanking, including sneak attack damage if within her sneak attack range.

Normal: A ranged weapon cannot be used to flank.
